test_title: PYST 40 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can do a job in 10 days and B in 12 days. They work on alternate days starting with A. In how many days will the job be finished?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do work in 10 days

B can do work in 12 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 10 and 12 = 60

⇒ Total work = 60 units

⇒ A’s 1 day work = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 units
